alloy.preparation: Alloy 1 from commercial low-C ferroalloys/electrolytic metals, melted in 20-pound (9.2 kg) air induction furnace; N varied using nitrided Mn. Ingots ground, hot rolled at 2200 °F (1205 °C) to 0.150 in. (3.8 mm), air annealed at 1950 °F (1070 °C) for 15 min, pickled in 10 pct HNO3:2 pct HF at 150 °F. Cold rolled 50 pct to 0.075 in. (1.9 mm), air annealed at 1950 °F for 7 min, repickled; further pickling removed the approximately 0.001 in. nitrogen-affected austenitized surface zone, reducing total thickness by 0.003 in. (0.075 mm). Specimens sheared from processed strip, degreased in hot 120 °F (50 °C) concentrated Alconox cleaner, thoroughly rinsed in water and alcohol.
alloy.microstructure: Duplex ferrite/austenite; approximate austenite fraction 36% from Figures 3/5, with phase balance determined by X-ray methods.

test_solution.preparation: 150–200 ml solution containing explicitly stated 1000 ppm Cl− as NaCl; pH standardized to 5.0 by acetic acid. Gas conditioning, solvent grade and numerical test temperature are not stated.

test_method.procedure_description: Johnson cell similar to Stern–Mackrides holder; flat Teflon gasket with 1/16 in. raised ring around 1 cm² hole. Platinum counter; SCE via KCl salt bridge capillary approximately 2 mm from face. Wenking potentiostat, X–Y recorder, motor-driven ramp. After electrolyte addition/electrical connection, equilibrate/passivate for 30 min at −0.3 to −0.1 V, then scan anodically at 0.7 V/h until pitting; overall scan approximately −0.3 to +1.0 V. One replication gave agreement within 0.04 V; this is not a statistical uncertainty.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Source-defined offset potential where anodic current exceeds 0.02 mA without later decrease below 0.02 mA (repassivation). Figure 1 displays the offset line on its current-density axis for the 1 cm² face. This criterion may include crevice pitting at the metal–Teflon interface as well as general pitting and is distinct from choosing an earlier current surge.

experiments.result_note: Potential where current exceeds 0.02 mA without subsequent repassivation; the paper notes crevice and general pitting may both begin. This is the source-defined offset criterion, not an independently inferred curve knee. Bulk Table I percent notation is retained without inventing a weight/atomic basis or Fe balance. Cleaning/pickling and anneal temperatures are not test temperature; separate electropolishing for X-ray phase analysis is not imposed on the pitting electrode. Figure 4 caption prints Alloy 1 N as 0.038%, whereas Table I and the N-coordinate presentation use 0.03; bulk analysis follows Table I and no anchor is replaced.
